canonical_record.label: FLM formula test in a trapped-ion HaPPY code
canonical_record.summary: The authors report experimental confirmation of the Faulkner-Lewkowycz-Maldacena formula in a trapped-ion implementation of the HaPPY holographic code.

assertions.statement: The authors report experimental confirmation of the Faulkner-Lewkowycz-Maldacena formula in a trapped-ion implementation of the HaPPY holographic code.

scope.population: A toy holographic duality implemented as the HaPPY quantum error-correcting code on a trapped-ion quantum computer
scope.assumptions: The experimental confirmation is claimed within the implemented model, rather than for physical quantum gravity generally.
scope.uncertainty: Author-reported experimental result; independent replication and generalization are not established by the supplied excerpt.

support.quote: Here, we implement a toy model of this duality called the HaPPY code, a quantum error-correcting code in the form of a tensor network with hyperbolic entanglement patterns, on a trapped-ion quantum computer. We present the first experimental confirmation of the Faulkner-Lewkowycz-Maldacena formula in this model - a key test of the holographic correspondence.
